Your Journey Begins With Us
Look ahead toward a future competing on a global level while enriching your local
community. The University of Texas at Tyler recognizes your drive, and we strive to
help you reach your goals every step of the way. Here, find the information you need
to apply as an international student and flourish on our welcoming campus.
Our International Community by the Numbers
+50
Countries represented.
Our students come from six continents to learn, grow and embark on their professional
careers.
281
International students.
You can find international students across our eight different colleges and schools.
+90
Undergraduate and graduate programs.
Whatever your path, you can find a program that can help you develop your talents
and reach your goals.
Admission Requirements
Your journey to UT Tyler begins with the application process. No matter if you apply
as a first-year undergraduate, transfer or graduate student, you must fulfill additional
admission requirements if you are an international student. If you have any questions,
please contact the Office of Undergraduate Admissions by email at admissions@uttyler.edu or by phone at 903.566.7457 or the Office of Graduate Admissions by phone at 903.566.7457
or by email at gradadmissions@uttyler.edu, based on how you plan to apply.
International Undergraduate Students
In order to apply, you must:
Complete an accredited high school program.
Meet the following requirements:
Top 25%*
Automatic Admissions
2nd Quartile*
Minimum of 2.75 GPA
3rd Quartile*
Minimum of 2.75 GPA
4th Quartile*
Minimum of 2.75 GPA
*If the school does not rank, you need a 2.75 GPA.
Follow these simple steps to complete your application:
Fill out an International Undergraduate Freshman Application on ApplyTexas. Our application opens Aug. 1.
Pay the $75 nonrefundable application fee.
Send your official high school transcript:
Transcripts from institutions outside of the United States must be translated (if
applicable) and must have a course-by-course evaluation with a Grade Point Average
(GPA). UT Tyler accepts original evaluations from the agencies listed below:
World Education Services (WES) (https://www.wes.org/evaluations-and-fees/education/university-of-texas-at-tyler/)
The Evaluation Company formerly SpanTran (https://spantran.com/) To view UT Tyler's
custom application portal for discounted evaluations: SpanTran Application. View the Documents Requirement page Document Requirements - evalcompany.com
SDR Educational Consultants (https://sdreducational.org/)
Global Credential Evaluator's. Inc (GCE)
International Education Research Foundation, Inc.
International Academic Credential Evaluators, Inc.
JSA: Joseph Silny & Associates, Inc.
International Education Evaluations (IEE)
If you have any questions regarding your transcript evaluation, please contact internationaladmissions@uttyler.edu.
Send Test Scores:
Students must provide qualifying scores for one of the following English proficiency
tests:
TOEFL: 79
IELTS: 6.5
Pearson: 53
Duolingo English Test: 105
ACT or SAT
UT Tyler does not require ACT or SAT test scores for admission to the 2022-2023 and
2023-2024 academic years. We still encourage students to send available scores for
class placement purposes.
If a student has graduated from high school in the United States, UT Tyler waives
the English Proficiency requirement.
International Transfer Students
You are considered a transfer student if you have 30 completed college hours and earned
a minimum 2.0 cumulative GPA. If you have below 30 hours, apply as an international
freshman.
Follow these simple steps to complete the application:
Fill out an International Undergraduate Transfer Application.
Pay the $75 nonrefundable application fee.
Send official copies of all college transcripts:
Transcripts from institutions outside of the United States must be translated (if
applicable) and must have a course-by-course evaluation with a Grade Point Average
(GPA). UT Tyler accepts original evaluations from the agencies listed below:
World Education Services (WES) (https://www.wes.org/evaluations-and-fees/education/university-of-texas-at-tyler/)
The Evaluation Company formerly SpanTran (https://spantran.com/) To view UT Tyler's
custom application portal for discounted evaluations: SpanTran Application. View the Documents Requirement page Document Requirements - evalcompany.com
SDR Educational Consultants (https://sdreducational.org/)
Global Credential Evaluator's. Inc (GCE)
International Education Research Foundation, Inc.
International Academic Credential Evaluators, Inc.
JSA: Joseph Silny & Associates, Inc. International Education Evaluations (IEE)
If you have any questions regarding your transcript evaluation, please contact internationaladmissions@uttyler.edu.
Provide proof of English proficiency.
International Graduate Students
Follow these steps to complete your application for graduate school:
Complete the graduate application at www.uttyler.edu/apply. Deadlines vary by program.
Pay the $75 nonrefundable application fee.
Submit official transcript(s):
Applicants with foreign transcripts must submit a detailed, course-by-course international
transcript evaluation. Transcripts from institutions outside of the United States
must be translated (if applicable) and must have a course-by-course evaluation with
a Grade Point Average (GPA). UT Tyler accepts original evaluations from any service
that is a current member of NACES. The following companies are commonly used:
World Education Services (WES)
The Evaluation Company (formerly SpanTran) - To view UT Tyler's custom application portal for discounted
evaluations: SpanTran Application. View the Documents Requirement page Document Requirements - evalcompany.com
Educational Credential Evaluators, Inc. (ECE)
Global Credential Evaluator's, Inc (GCE)
International Education Research Foundation, Inc.
International Academic Credential Evaluators, Inc. The following programs do not require an evaluation unless specifically requested
by the program: MS Computer Science, MS Civil Engineering, MS Electrical Engineering,
MS Engineering Leadership, and MS Mechanical Engineering. If you have any questions
regarding your transcript evaluation, please contact GradAdmissions@uttyler.edu.
Submit proof of English proficiency.
Submit additional departmental requirements: Some programs require additional materials
for admission such as letters of recommendation, a resume, a statement of purpose
and/or portfolios. Refer to the admission requirements of the program to which you are applying to determine if and what additional requirements
should be submitted.
Proof of English Proficiency
Applicants with an undergraduate degree from a foreign institution must submit results
of an English proficiency examination. Evidence of English proficiency must be submitted
before UT Tyler grants admission.
Accepted tests are the Test of English as a Foreign Language, the Pearson Test of English, the International English Language Testing System or the Duolingo English Test.
Minimum scores are as follows:
DET– 105
TOEFL – 79 (iBT) or 550 (pBT)
IELTS – 6.5 band score with 6.0 in each subsection
PTE Academic – 53
EIKEN – Grade 1
NOTE: Applicants to graduate psychology and counseling programs must have a minimum TOEFL
score of 87, an IELTS score of 7.0 with 6.5 or greater in each subsection or a DET
score of 115.
UT Tyler’s Educational Testing Service code for TOEFL is 6850. An institutional code is not required to submit your official IELTS scores. Please
contact your IELTS testing center to request that your IELTS scores be electronically
transmitted to UT Tyler. Please provide this exact information to your testing center:
The University of Texas at Tyler
Office of Graduate Admissions
3900 University Blvd
HPR 272
Tyler, TX, 75799
Exemptions
There are some exemptions to our language proficiency requirement. Each exemption
is outlined below:
Applicants who have completed a high school diploma, associate, bachelor’s, master’s,
doctoral or professional degree from a U.S. academic institution are not required
to submit English proficiency test scores. UT Tyler requires official transcripts
for confirmation.
Students who have earned a grade of “B” or higher in ENGL 1301 and ENGL 1302 (or equivalent)
from an accredited U.S. academic institution are not required to submit English proficiency
test scores. UT Tyler requires official transcripts for confirmation.
Individuals who complete Level 6 of The University of Texas at Tyler's Intensive English
Language Institute with no grade lower than “A” or who complete Level 7 with no grade
lower than “B” may be eligible for a language proficiency waiver.
Naturalized U.S. citizens.
Applicants from one of the following countries or those who have earned a bachelor’s,
master’s, doctoral or professional degree from one of the following countries are
exempt from the TOEFL or IELTS requirement. Official transcripts are required for
confirmation. View exempt countries:
American Samoa
Australia
Bahamas
Barbados
Belize
Canada (except Quebec)
Dominica
Ghana
Grand Cayman
Grenada
Ireland
Jamaica
Kenya
Liberia
New Zealand
Nigeria
Sierra Leone
Trinidad/Tobago
Turks and Caicos Islands
United Kingdom
U.S. Pacific Trust

Financial Aid for International Students
Explore scholarships for freshmen and transfers, including several exclusively reserved
for international students. For graduate candidates, assistantships and a new international
fellowship help cover the cost of your education. Navigate your financial aid options
with our admissions team.

Scholarships for International Undergraduate Students
Once You’re Admitted
You are so close to becoming a full member of the UT Tyler community! Once accepted
into a program of your choice, prepare to secure your student visa and save your spot.
Admitted Student Checklist
This helpful checklist details everything you need to begin your studies. It includes
the different documents you need to apply for a student visa, health requirements,
information on planning your life at Tyler and what to do once you arrive.
Form I-20
The I-20 form starts the visa application. It shows that you have enough financial
resources to study and live in the U.S. Find out what documents you need to receive
it.
International Student Services
The Office of International Programs supports our international students through a
wide variety of services. Get assistance with topics like visa requirements, health
benefits, employment, travel and adapting to life in the United States.
Visa Information
Our step-by-step visa instructions make the process easier and less stressful. Review
all information for obtaining an F-1 or J-1 visa, and don’t hesitate to reach out
if you have any questions.
Next Steps
Follow your future all the way to The University of Texas at Tyler. We are here to
help you reach your goals and support you as you make our campus your new home.
